shopDesigns.title: Designs
shopDesigns.subtitle: Create a Design, add its photos and price, and publish it when it is complete.
shopDesigns.empty: No designs yet. Create the first one.
shopDesigns.loadFailed: The designs could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

editor.priceFailed: The other changes were saved, but the price was not.

fields.name: Name
fields.taxCodeHint: The tax codes that have a tax rate in the shop settings.
fields.priceRupees: Price in rupees (whole rupees, tax included)

photos.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {{maxMb}} MB each and {{maxFiles}} photos in all. Mark one photo as the fabric close-up. Location and camera details are removed from each photo.
photos.uploaded: Photos uploaded. Save the design to keep them.
photos.tooMany: A design holds at most {{maxFiles}} photos. Remove some before adding more.
photos.reconfirm: I confirm the new photos show the saree's true colour.
photos.reconfirmHint: This design is published, so new photos need your confirmation again.

publishing.intro: Publishing puts the design in the shop. Everything below must be present.
publishing.confirm: I confirm the photos show the saree's true colour.
publishing.refused: This design cannot be published yet. Missing:
publishing.refusedSave: These changes were not saved, because the published design would be missing:

missing.taxBand: A tax rate for this tax code and price
missing.otherPhoto: At least one photo besides the close-up
missing.trueColourConfirmation: Your confirmation that the photos show the true colour
missing.salesChannel: A sales channel (the store's default sales channel)
missing.shippingProfile: A shipping profile (the store's default shipping profile)

errors.input.invalid: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.money.invalid_shelf_price: The price must be a whole number of rupees, more than zero.
errors.design.unknown_tax_code: That tax code has no tax rate in the shop settings. Use a tax code that has one, such as saree.
errors.design.not_publishable: This design cannot be published yet.
errors.tax.no_band: No tax rate fits this price, so a published design cannot have it.
errors.design.not_draft: Only an unpublished design can be published.
errors.design.unknown_photo: A photo could not be found in the shop's storage. Remove it and upload it again.
errors.request.cross_origin: The request was refused because it did not come from this admin. Reload the page and try again.

validation.name: Enter a name.
validation.price: Enter a price in whole rupees, from 1 to {{max}}.
validation.metres: Enter metres above 0 and up to 100, with at most two decimals.
validation.metresRequired: Enter the measurement in metres; a saved value cannot be left empty.
validation.fix: Check the fields marked in red.

uploadReasons.too_large: A photo is larger than {{maxMb}} MB.
uploadReasons.too_many_files: At most {{maxFiles}} photos can be uploaded at once.
uploadReasons.unexpected_field: The upload contained something other than photos.
uploadReasons.not_an_image: A file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo that can be opened.
uploadReasons.unreadable: The upload could not be read. Try again.
